st-batch-stream.title: Four jobs and the mode each one needs
st-batch-stream.description: Four jobs at one marketplace compared: payouts and the ledger report suit a nightly batch, while stolen card checks and a live dashboard suit a stream.
st-batch-stream.note: Ask what decision changes if this number arrives an hour sooner.

st-log.title: One keyed record through a partitioned log
st-log.description: A producer hashes the key to choose a partition, the partition appends the record at the next offset, one member of a consumer group reads it, and the committed offset marks where a restart resumes.
st-log.note: Order holds within one partition, not across the whole topic.

st-delivery.title: What a crash between work and commit costs
st-delivery.description: Four approaches compared: committing first can lose a record, working first can repeat it, an idempotent effect makes a repeat harmless, and a transactional effect commits the result and offset together.
st-delivery.note: Exactly once describes the effect, built on at-least-once delivery.

st-cdc.title: One committed update reaches the search index and cache
st-cdc.description: A committed row change enters the database log, a connector reads the log, a change topic carries the event keyed by primary key, and the search index and cache apply it.
st-cdc.note: Copies follow the log and lag behind; the app makes no second write.

st-event-time.title: One minute of events and one late arrival
st-event-time.description: A one-minute window stays open until a watermark passes its end, the window emits its count, and an event stamped inside that minute then arrives late.
st-event-time.note: A late event is dropped, updates the result, or goes to a side output.

st-schema.title: Removing a field: readers change first
st-schema.description: To remove an Avro field that has no default, upgrade consumers so they skip it, then upgrade producers so new records omit it, and the field leaves the log once retention expires.
st-schema.note: Upgrade producers first and old readers fail on the first new record.

items.title: Retention expires
items.detail: field is gone from the log
